run_Lumina2Pipeline: run the Lumina2Pipeline to generate images from text prompts using a diffusion model
run_Lumina2Pipeline_encode_prompt: encode text prompts into Gemma2 hidden state embeddings with attention masks for image generation
run_Lumina2Pipeline_call: call the Lumina2Pipeline __call__ method to perform denoising loop and generate images with classifier-free guidance
run_Lumina2Pipeline_prepare_latents: prepare random latent tensors with correct batch size, channels, height and width for diffusion inference
run_calculate_shift: calculate the shift parameter mu for flow matching scheduler based on image sequence length
